title: Route-specific write semantics
summary: Write behaviour belongs to the route/view through which an object is accessed. The same base object can be DIRECT through one path, TRACKED through another, and READ_ONLY through a third.
invariants: TRACKED and COPY_ON_WRITE changes do not silently mutate the base object visible through another route.
READ_ONLY is an additional Storage constraint, never a grant of access or permission.
DIRECT advances the route binding; VERSIONED/COPY_ON_WRITE/TRACKED preserve explicit change evidence according to their contracts.
Destruction of the underlying StorageObject is distinct from unlink/exclusion of one namespace binding.

provenance.claim: Regression proves DIRECT/TRACKED/READ_ONLY route-specific mutation behaviour.
